requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: defaultAdmin() and the REBASER_ROLE holder, an intermediary Overseer V1 controller whose owner() was checked live, both resolve to the same 4-of-6 Gnosis Safe. No delay stands in front of it.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10. Scored 65 / 70 / 0 with an oracle-authority score of 100 and crossExposure 100. The audited token is stHYPE (0xffaa4a3d…6cc1), not wstHYPE, the ERC-4626 wrapper around it. The root Safe was checked for signer overlap with the root Safes of Kinetiq, HyperLend and para, and none was found.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
getMinDelay() on the holder (OpenZeppelin TimelockController), in seconds
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xffaa4a3d97fe9107cef8a3f48c069f577ff76cc1","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","latest"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"latest"]}'
# getMinDelay() on the holder (OpenZeppelin TimelockController), in seconds
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0xc5ded4f7f53919c714059a17d31371ae847e23d2","data":"0xf27a0c92"},"latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xffaa4a3d97fe9107cef8a3f48c069f577ff76cc1","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
